extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism closeout from XML/PDF/supplement evidence; replaced automated membrane/nucleic-acid placeholders with beta-catenin PROTAC/Wnt pathway mechanism claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: xStAx-VHLL is source-supported as a PROTAC beta-catenin degrader: it binds beta-catenin, promotes beta-catenin ubiquitination, and proteasome/VHL-ligase perturbation blocks or modulates degradation.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact band-intensity values are plotted in figures and not fully text-tabulated; the mechanism assignment is based on source-located assay type and qualitative/statistical figure/prose evidence, not fabricated numeric extraction.

source_locator.locator: xml:fig=1:Fig. 1c-d; supp:Supplementary Fig. S2; supp:Supplementary Fig. S5

mechanism_claims.claim_text: xStAx-VHLL inhibits Wnt/beta-catenin signaling in cell and organoid systems, including Topflash reporter reduction and decreased Wnt target gene expression.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is pathway activity evidence downstream of beta-catenin degradation; it should not be recast as antimicrobial membrane or nucleic-acid mechanism.

source_locator.locator: xml:fig=2:Fig. 2a-c; xml:fig=4:Fig. 4c; xml:fig=5:Fig. 5e; supp:Supplementary Fig. S6/S8

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper source-supports anticancer phenotypes for xStAx-VHLL: reduced colorectal cancer cell proliferation, reduced mouse intestinal tumor burden, and inhibited patient-derived colorectal tumor organoid survival.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotype assays support anticancer activity context but do not support DRAMP's antimicrobial label, MIC values, or hemolysis/toxicity records.

caution_findings.evidence_context: No local primary evidence supports antimicrobial membrane/nucleic-acid mechanism for these peptides.
Several effect sizes are plotted but not text-tabulated; mechanism claims avoid fabricated exact values.
